左纳乌装置是王国之泪的建造系统核心：风扇、翼、轮胎、炮台、电池，组合起来能上天、能下水、能打怪。但装置种类多，新手容易每个都试一遍却没一个好用。本篇先列清 27 种装置，再讲三个经过验证的实用造物，照着配就能用。

Zonai devices are the core of Tears of the Kingdom's building system: fans, wings, wheels, cannons, and batteries can be combined to fly, cross water, and fight monsters. But with so many device types, beginners easily try each one without any of them working well. This guide first lists all 27 devices clearly, then covers three proven practical builds — follow the builds and they will work.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key points of this guide
左纳乌装置共 27 种：风扇机、翼、平台车、热气球、火箭、定时炸弹、便携锅、火焰/冰冻/雷电放射器、光线头、放水栓、操纵杆、大轮胎、小轮胎、雪橇、电池、大电池、弹簧、大炮、平衡器、浮游石、灯、桩子、镜子、追踪平台车、魔像的头部。

There are 27 Zonai devices in total: Fan, Wing, Cart, Balloon, Rocket, Time Bomb, Portable Pot, Flame/Frost/Shock Emitter, Beam Emitter, Hydrant, Steering Stick, Big Wheel, Small Wheel, Sled, Battery, Big Battery, Spring, Cannon, Stabilizer, Hover Stone, Light, Stake, Mirror, Homing Cart, and Construct Head.
双风扇飞行车：2 个风扇 + 1 个操纵杆，操纵杆 45° 装法，蓝图 9 左纳尼乌姆。
Two-fan hover bike: 2 Fans + 1 Steering Stick, with the Steering Stick mounted at 45°, Autobuild costs up to 9 Zonaite (0 if you already own all parts).
魔像头 + 大炮自动炮台：魔像头会自己瞄准，配大炮就是自动火力点。
Construct Head + Cannon auto turret: the Construct Head aims on its own, and paired with a Cannon it becomes an automatic fire point.
追踪车炮台 9 矿、大轮胎 + 龙头旋转炮台 6 矿，成本要提前算好。

The Homing Cart turret costs up to 9 Zonaite (0 if you already own all parts), and the Big Wheel + Construct Head rotating turret costs up to 6 Zonaite (0 if you already own all parts) — work out the costs in advance.
装置从制造机用左纳乌能源或魔像角抽胶囊；人马咆哮会摧毁装置，别在人马面前摆炮台。
Devices are drawn as capsules from Device Dispensers using Zonaite or Construct Horns; a Lynel's roar destroys devices, so don't set up turrets in front of a Lynel.

27 种装置按功能可以分四组：动力组（风扇机、翼、热气球、火箭、轮胎、雪橇）、武器组（大炮、火焰/冰冻/雷电放射器、光线头、魔像的头部）、功能组（便携锅、放水栓、操纵杆、电池、大电池、弹簧、平衡器、浮游石、灯、桩子、镜子、追踪平台车、定时炸弹、平台车）。记住分组比死记名字有用：缺动力补风扇轮胎，缺火力补大炮和魔像头，缺续航补电池。

The 27 devices can be split into four groups by function: propulsion (Fan, Wing, Balloon, Rocket, wheels, Sled), weapons (Cannon, Flame/Frost/Shock Emitter, Beam Emitter, Construct Head), and utility (Portable Pot, Hydrant, Steering Stick, Battery, Big Battery, Spring, Stabilizer, Hover Stone, Light, Stake, Mirror, Homing Cart, Time Bomb, Cart). Remembering the groups is more useful than memorizing names: if you lack propulsion, add fans and wheels; if you lack firepower, add cannons and Construct Heads; if you lack endurance, add batteries.
最实用的飞行造物是双风扇飞行车：2 个风扇 + 1 个操纵杆，操纵杆按 45° 装法，蓝图成本 9 左纳尼乌姆。风扇提供升力和前进动力，操纵杆控制方向，结构简单、故障率低，是跑图和上天空岛的主力。造的时候注意风扇朝向一致，装反一个就会原地打转。

The most practical flying build is the two-fan hover bike: 2 Fans + 1 Steering Stick, with the Steering Stick mounted at 45°, and an Autobuild cost of 9 Zonaite. The fans provide lift and forward thrust, the Steering Stick controls direction, and the simple structure with a low failure rate makes it the workhorse for traversing the map and reaching Sky Islands. When building it, make sure the fans face the same direction — mounting one backwards will make it spin in place.
载具建造：先定用途，再选装置组合（游戏实机截图）
Vehicle building: decide the purpose first, then pick the device combination (in-game screenshot)
魔像的头部会自己瞄准敌人，配上大炮就是自动炮台：放下后不用管，它会自己开火。
The Construct Head aims at enemies on its own, and paired with a Cannon it becomes an automatic turret: once placed, you can leave it alone and it will fire by itself.
适合守点和清营地，但要注意炮台是固定火力，敌人跑出射程就打不到了。
It suits holding positions and clearing camps, but note that the turret is fixed firepower — once an enemy runs out of range, it can no longer hit them.
炮台怕人马咆哮，见本站人马完全指南：人马一声吼，装置全碎，别在人马面前摆炮台。
Turrets are vulnerable to a Lynel's roar; see this site's Complete Lynel Guide: one Lynel roar shatters every device, so don't set up turrets in front of a Lynel.
追踪平台车会自己追踪敌人，配上武器就是移动炮台，成本 9 矿；大轮胎 + 龙头旋转炮台成本 6 矿，龙头会旋转扫射，适合对付成群的敌人。两种炮台的成本都要提前算好矿，别造到一半发现矿不够。矿的主要来源是地底和制造机周边的矿床。

The Homing Cart tracks enemies on its own, and fitted with a weapon it becomes a mobile turret, costing up to 9 Zonaite (0 if you already own all parts); the Big Wheel + Construct Head rotating turret costs up to 6 Zonaite (0 if you already own all parts), and the dragon head rotates while firing, which suits groups of enemies. Work out the Zonaite costs of both turrets in advance, so you don't run out halfway through building. Zonaite mainly comes from the Depths and from ore deposits near Device Dispensers.
装置胶囊从制造机抽取，消耗左纳乌能源或魔像角。抽之前先想好要什么装置，别把能源浪费在用不上的装置上。使用禁忌就一条：人马咆哮会摧毁附近的左纳乌装置和蓝图造物，打人马时别依赖造物，靠闪避和骑背才是正路。

Device capsules are drawn from Device Dispensers, consuming Zonaite Charges or Construct Horns. Decide what device you want before drawing, and don't waste Zonaite on devices you won't use. There is just one usage taboo: a Lynel's roar destroys nearby Zonai devices and Autobuild creations, so don't rely on builds when fighting a Lynel — dodging and mounting its back is the right approach.
左纳乌载具：动力、武器、续航要平衡（游戏实机截图）
Zonai vehicles: propulsion, weapons, and endurance must be balanced (in-game screenshot)
